generator.recipe: connected river tree → graded valley cross-sections → coherent upland relief

candidate.notes: Fictional seeded constructive river/valley shape. Horizontal and vertical units: metres. Designed beds rise upstream with matching confluences. Raster drainage, discharge, erosion and water budgets are not certified. Physical extent is explicit; raster resolution never rescales geometry.

provenance.placement: Native shape translated to the saved candidate; one parent datum, no local origin relocation
provenance.scope: An explicit local L2 design example; adjacent native domains and adoption into the global runtime are unresolved
provenance.water: Designed channels with illustrative 400mm/year runoff; external river inflow, drinking water and flood recurrence unresolved

limitations: Assignment ignores terrain slopes, divides, depressions and groundwater; NOT a topographically validated watershed.
Synthetic runoff is already net supply, not rainfall; no regional weather claim or calibration to an old ledger.
Steady annual-mean bookkeeping only; no storage, losses, seasons, flood peaks, hydraulic capacity or channel-width inference.
Confluences and cell inputs are quantized to existing segments; no new barriers or geometry edits.

method.area: (columns-1)*(rows-1) nonoverlapping cells; one centre sample per cell
method.assignment: Nearest designed polyline segment in metres; equal-distance ties use river input order then segment order
method.externalInputPlacement: Uppermost segment of the named existing river
method.flow: Paths run downstream-to-upstream; child outlet enters parent at nearest confluence segment; accumulate in reverse segment order
method.lineWeight: 0.6 + 5.4*sqrt(segment conceptual flow / largest outlet flow); display pixels only

scenario.name: Illustrative uniform net runoff, no external supply

water.status: PROVISIONAL SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION; NOT A VALIDATED WATERSHED
